name: Liebenberg-Denkmal
description:
The Liebenberg Monument in Vienna's 1st district, opposite the University of Vienna, honors Johann Andreas von Liebenberg, mayor from 1680 to 1683.

Liebenberg gained recognition for combating a plague epidemic in 1679 and played a key role during the Second Siege of Vienna in 1683. He led defensive efforts, organized a citizen's militia, and inspired perseverance, but he died two days before the decisive victory over the Turks. The monument symbolizes this triumph.

It features a stepped pedestal with a 9-meter-high obelisk, a bronze lion, and gilded accents. Two bronze putti hold Liebenberg's portrait, while a double-headed eagle and inscription adorn the back. The obelisk is crowned by Victoria, the goddess of victory.

![](https://wien.denkmal-3d.at/SF/liebenberg.jpg)

name: San Martín de Salas
description: La iglesia de San Martín se encuentra ubicada a un kilómetro de la villa de Salas, en un lugar próximo al río Nonaya. El 3 de junio del año 1931 es declarada por real decreto monumento nacional de interés histórico-artístico. Como consecuencia de las sucesivas transformaciones constructivas experimentadas a lo largo del tiempo, la iglesia conservada hoy es un edificio de 28 metros de longitud por 9 de ancho y 9 de altura. Se encuentra dividida en tres espacios nítidamente diferenciados. Al exterior, los paramentos están conformados por mampostería unida por morteros de diversa calidad. Conserva cuatro contrafuertes integrados por buenos sillares, ubicados en coincidencia interna con las esquinas del espacio cuadrangular que configura el presbiterio. se encuentra orientada 30 grados al noroeste respecto al eje este-oeste, y fue rehecha en su totalidad hacia finales del siglo xv. Se puede deducir, que la primitiva iglesia de San Martín fuera una fundación de Alfonso III, hecha sobre otra iglesia más antigua

name: Former Artillery Train Station Photogrammetry
description:
After the Tsarist Russia established the Vilnius Military District army camp and training ground, a railway station “Poligon” with a water tower and a water pumping station was built in the military town in 1894 by the Varėnės lake. In 1925, when the railway board decided to close the bridge over the Nemunas in Alytus due to its extremely poor technical condition, the branch to Varėna was abandoned and later dismantled. In 1930, it was decided to build the “Dainava” sanatorium in the former Artillery Station, and the huts of the station with 40 ha of land were leased to the Kaunas City Sick Fund. The sanatorium was established in 1932.

📸 The model was processed from 940 high-resolution photos.

Created as part of the project:

“Fort-Union – Integration of the Polish–Lithuanian Network of Fortifications for the Development of Representative Tourism Products”

name: DAE Diorama - Grandma's House
description:
**This is my final assignment for the DAE 3D1 course.**

**Modelled in Blender, textured in Photoshop.**


I had never worked with any 3D modeling software before, so I had my struggles, but overall, I had a lot of fun (and a few tears from missing my grandmothers) while finishing this.

This diorama was inspired by the homes of my late grandmothers, where I spent much of my childhood. Set in Indonesia, this diorama combines local architecture with Chinese-Indonesian influences.

The scene is meant to give the viewers the warm, nostalgic feeling of looking back at memories, and hopefully bring them back to a moment in their own childhood—full of warmth, carefree, curious, and free from the worries of the real world.

Big thanks to my mama, my cousin Jevon, and Neea for the reference photos, my family and my partner for all their support, my sister for her drawing, Usagi for their encouragement and feedback, Fitz for amazing feedback, and everyone I’ve shared my updates with along the way.

name: Mayawel, Señora del Maguey y la Luna Fértil
description:
Desde el corazón de la tierra sagrada emerge Mayawel, doncella divina del maguey, madre del néctar y guardiana de la abundancia. Su espíritu habita entre pencas verdes y raíces antiguas, allí donde los pueblos ancestrales escuchaban la voz de la luna sobre los campos.

Su figura porta la fuerza de la fertilidad y el misterio de los ciclos eternos: vida, muerte y renacimiento. Los antiguos la honraban como dadora del pulque sagrado, bebida ritual que unía a los hombres con los dioses y con la memoria del maíz, del sol y de la lluvia.

Tallada con esencia precolombina, esta representación invoca la estética ceremonial de los pueblos mesoamericanos: símbolos orgánicos, poder femenino y conexión espiritual con la naturaleza. Mayawel aparece serena y poderosa, como una deidad nacida del barro, del jade y del humo de copal, eterna protectora de la tierra fértil y de los saberes ancestrales.

name: Vercetti Estate building
description:
This is my attempt at recreating the Vercetti Estate from GTA Vice City as a 3D model. Honestly speaking, this project was really hard for me. I tried as much as I possibly could, but I wasn’t able to achieve the same level of detail as the original game asset.

One big reason is that my computer can’t handle very high-level textures and heavy geometry, so I had to limit a lot of things while modeling. Also, I’m still learning and not very skilled yet, so some parts may look simple or less accurate.

Still, I gave it my best effort with the skills and resources I currently have. This model represents my learning process, and I’m planning to keep improving and make changes in the future as I get better.

No judgement please — this is a step forward for me, and I’ll continue doing my best.

name: Ruby-topaz hummingbird
description:
3D scan of a ruby-topaz hummingbird (*Chrysolampis mosquitus*). 

The ruby-topaz hummingbird is a species of hummingbird which lives in Nort-East and Centre-East South America. It is 8 to 9.5 cm long and weighs 2.5 to 5 g. Its almost straight, black bill is relatively short compared to those of most other hummingbirds. It inhabits the interior and edges of open savanna-like landscapes and shrubby arid hillsides where it feeds on nectar from a wide variety of flowering shrubs, trees, epiphytes, cacti, and crops.


Specimen: Ruby-topaz hummingbird, *Chrysolampis mosquitus* (Linnaeus, 1758)

Inventory number: AV 7026

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa 

Find out more about the Museum at https://www.msn.unipi.it/it/

name: Ear Bone of a Whale
description: The ear bone of a whale, known as the tympanic bulla, is one of the most distinctive and valuable parts of its skeleton for scientific study. Unlike in many other mammals, whale ear bones are extremely dense and isolated from the skull, allowing them to detect underwater sound with incredible sensitivity. These adaptations are crucial for communication, navigation, and hunting in the deep ocean. Fossilized whale ear bones also help researchers identify species and understand whale evolution due to their unique shapes and durability.

description:
Samuel Hamilton Miller, MBE (born 11 November 1933), is a Northern Irish motorcycle racer, champion in road racing and trials. He was appointed a Member of the Order of the British Empire (MBE) in the 2009 New Year Honours for services to motorcycling heritage.[1] In 2013, Miller was named a FIM Legend for his motorcycling achievements.
He also finished third in the 1957 250cc Grand Prix Championship. In competition, he rode a variety of machines, including AJS 7R, Mondial, and NSU. Miller won three rounds of the North West 200 in the 250cc class (1956–1958).
Miller primarily rode Ariel motorcycles, competing in trials and the Isle of Man Tourist Trophy. When Ariel was acquired by BSA in 1964, he partnered with the Spanish firm Bultaco and became the leading designer of modern two-stroke trials motorcycles.

name: Wood Statue Boy with Dog - Einscan Rigil
description:
## Scanning
Scanning was done in PC connected mode (WiFi, with latest update 120FPS speed) at a moderate high point distance of 0.15mm (can go up/down to 0.05mm but at 0.15mm it already resulted in a 15M triangle file...) until target quality was reached. Keep an eye on ideal scan distance since it reduces with increasing point distance.
I placed the statue on bed of marker cards and geometries so I can also capture the sides of the statue which I also use for aligning the two scans I created (top and bottom). The scan itself was performed with both cross and parallel line mode taking roughly 5min for scanning. No scan spray was used for scanning.

## Post-Processing
When finishing the single scans it already creates a point cloud so I only had to align using automatic feature alignment (after deleting all unnecessary data from around the object). Afterwards I used Quicksurface to align the scan to the coordinate system and reduce the triangle count to a manageable 4M triangles.

name: ABYSSINIAN ROLLER
description:
Abyssinian Roller adalah burung berukuran sedang dengan panjang tubuh mencapai 28–30 cm, ditambah bulu ekor tengah yang memanjang hingga total sekitar 37 cm pada individu dewasa. Tubuh bagian atas didominasi warna biru kehijauan cerah dengan punggung cokelat kayu manis yang kontras jelas dengan warna kepala dan sayap. Bagian bawah tubuh, termasuk dada dan perut, berwarna biru muda lembut, sementara sayapnya menunjukkan gradasi biru tua kehitaman dan hijau zamrud.

Kepalanya relatif besar dan bulat, disertai paruh kuat berwarna hitam yang lurus dan cukup tebal, ideal untuk menangkap serangga besar seperti kumbang dan belalang. Mata berwarna gelap dengan lingkar mata tipis berwarna kusam, memberikan ekspresi tajam namun tenang.

Bulu ekornya menonjol, terdiri dari dua helai bulu tengah yang sangat memanjang dan berujung runcing, tampak mencolok baik saat terbang maupun bertengger. Kakinya berukui ke belakang, tiga ke depan), memungkinkan cengkeraman kuat pada dahan ketika menunggu mangsa lewat.

name: Charcoal Black Dark Dragon
description:
A massive charcoal-black dark dragon with a long, sinewy body covered in rough, volcanic scales.
Glowing red, vein-like markings pulse faintly across its sides and wings, giving the creature a molten, almost living-lava appearance.

Its head is sharp and predatory — shaped like a mix of bird of prey and ancient wyrm, with jagged teeth and deep-set, undead-looking eyes. Two long, ivory horns sweep backward from the skull, while smaller spikes and ridges run along the neck and spine, enhancing its aggressive silhouette.

The enormous wings stretch out like torn leather sails, heavily creased and reinforced by dark bone structures underneath. The membranes look weathered and scarred, as if the dragon has survived countless battles.

The overall pose is coiled and threatening — wings partially unfurled, head lowered, ready to strike with ancient intelligence and lethal intent.

A deadly, volcanic, battle-scarred dragon — alive, aware, and terrifying.

name: 19th century Mausoleum
description:
The municipality of Zempoala, located 107 kilometers from Mexico City, is part of the state of Hidalgo. In the pre-Hispanic period, it was inhabited by Toltec and Chichimeca groups; it was later evangelized in 1527 by Franciscan friars and founded by the Spanish around 1540. 
It is historically significant as the primary water catchment site of springs on the slopes of Cerro de Tecajete, feeding the Aqueduct of Padre Tembleque, whose arcades extend approximately 48 km to Otumba. Other significant sites include the Parish of All Saints and the municipal cemetery;the former preserves sacramental burial records dating back to 1670. 
Following the Reform Laws of 1859, burials shifted to the civil sphere, and 19th-century tombs and mausoleums can be found. This mausoleum features carved stone and red plastered walls.

name: The 5th Seed - Queens University Concept
description: **The Fifth Seed** is an Afro-Indigenous futurist public art installation by AstroSankofa’s Jamera DaCosta and Quentin VerCetty, proposed for Queen’s University’s Isabel Bader Centre for the Performing Arts. The work draws from the teachings of the Indigenous medicine wheel through abstraction, plant knowledge systems, and cosmic symbolism. A central floral sculptural form is encircled by four directional seed sculptures, each reflecting distinct states of being and ancestral knowledge. A collaboratively designed engraved platform—developed with Black and Indigenous students and knowledge holders—grounds the installation. Using durable, low-impact materials such as dye-sublimated aluminum and cast stone, the project embodies sustainability, mentorship, and cultural continuity, inviting reflection on interconnected pasts and shared futures.

name: Edward O'Donoghue (1832-1906) Memorial
description: One of 240 memorials recorded in Old Terryglass graveyard (TN006-003008-), Co. Tipperary. 20th-century memorial cross marking the grave of Edward (Edmund) O'Donoghue (O'Donohoe) (born c. 1832) of Santa Cruse House, mill-owner & farmer, Justice of Peace, Carrigahorig who died 16th of April,1906 aged 74, his son John C. O'Donoghue (born c. 1868) who died on the 16th of June, 1906 aged 38 & James C (harlie) O'Donoghue (born c. 1873)  who died in Woodstock Hotel, South Africa, on the 5th of October, 1909 aged 36. Memorial cross erected by his wife Bridget M. O'Donoghue nee Delaney.  The memorial stone is topped with a budded ringed cross with intertwined I H S Christogram.  Below the cross the stone is decorated with a harp surrounded by shamrocks springing from the base.  The budded cross (also known as the Apostles' Cross) is a Christian symbol featuring trefoil (three-lobed) or scalloped shapes at the end of each arm. For more details visit; https://historicgraves.com/terryglass-old-cemetery/tn-tygs-0053/grave

description:
Breathe life into your digital world with this Overgrown Medieval Voxel Manor, a stunning example of high-fidelity voxel artistry. This 3D model expertly balances traditional European architectural elements with a whimsical, blocky aesthetic. The design features a prominent timber-framed second story over a sturdy stone foundation, highlighted by a steeply pitched, weathered clay-tile roof and twin masonry chimneys.

name: The Metropolitan Cathedral of Timișoara
description:
The Metropolitan Cathedral of Timișoara is an iconic Romanian Orthodox church located in the heart of Timișoara, Romania. Built between 1936 and 1946, the cathedral showcases a distinctive Moldavian architectural style, blended with Byzantine influences, making it one of the most impressive religious structures in the country. Its 90.5-meter-high central tower dominates the city skyline, and the interior is adorned with intricate frescoes, wood carvings, and religious icons.

The cathedral can accommodate over 5,000 people and houses a valuable collection of religious art and historical artifacts. It also serves as the seat of the Archbishop of Timișoara and the Metropolis of Banat. Beyond its religious significance, the cathedral played a symbolic role during the Romanian Revolution of 1989, when demonstrators gathered around it to protest against the communist regime. Today, it stands as both a spiritual sanctuary and a powerful monument to Romanian history and identity.

name: Trilobit 1 "walk"
description:
Trilobit 1 "walk"

Im Rahmen des Arbeitsstipendium für Performance der Stadt Wien 2024 („soil“) stellt Andrea Nagl die Frage, wie die darstellende Kunst von Tanz und Performance, unterstützt durch digitale Tools, wissenschaftlich fundierte Einblicke in Erdgeschichte und Geologie zu einer immersiven und emotional resonanten Erfahrung machen kann.

Ein Foto eines aus Fimo gebastelten Trilobiten-Models wurde mit Hilfe der AI-Plattform meshy animiert.
Der Einsatz von künstlicher Intelligenz ermöglicht einen techno-evolutionären Simulationsprozess im Sinne einer Erweiterung der bildlichen Vorstellungskraft vergangenen Lebens.

nagl～wintersberger

Die Trilobiten („Dreilapper“) sind eine ausgestorbene Klasse meeresbewohnender Gliederfüßer (Arthropoda), die nahezu während der gesamten Spanne des Paläozoikums existierten und aufgrund ihrer zahlreichen Erhaltung sie zu wichtigen Leitfossilien für das Paläozoikum, insbesondere des Kambrium macht. 
Aus: https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trilobiten

description:
A Grand Unified Theory (GUT) is a physics concept aiming to merge the strong, weak, and electromagnetic forces into a single framework, suggesting they are different aspects of one force at extremely high energies, like those in the early universe.

While electroweak unification (strong/weak/EM) is confirmed, a complete GUT remains theoretical, with models like SU(5) and SO(10) proposing how these forces unify and predicting phenomena like proton decay, though experimental evidence is lacking. 

GUTs are a step toward a Theory of Everything (ToE), which would also include gravity.

name: Apex Stegosaurus (Point Cloud)
description:
Digitized using Gaussian Splatting via [Luma 3D](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/luma-3d-capture/id1615849914)

This was made with Luma 3D and captures the Apex Stegosaurus, now on display at the Gilder Center at the American Museum of Natural History (AMNH).
It’s one of the most complete Stegosaurus skeletons ever discovered—found in 2022 in Colorado and brought to AMNH for exhibition and research.
The skeleton’s amazing condition offers rare insights into dinosaur anatomy and life during the Jurassic period.


More info about the exhibit: [AMNH website](https://www.amnh.org/exhibitions/apex-stegosaurus-fossil)

name: penrose-tiling-rhombi_002
description:
This is my 3D *dimetric\** interpretation of the below Penrose aperiodic tiling P3.   
[![](//w.wiki/9vt9)](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Penrose_Tiling_(Rhombi).svg)  
My brain usually trained to see isometric cubes shapes in hexagon-based patterns with 30°/60° angles can’t help but try to also see some in patterns for which it is less obvious like that one based on 72° angles (five-fold symmetry), so this far-fetched interpretation of mine is a structure where, unlike in the Wieringa roof, the rhombi are not congruent but a majority (about ⅔) of them are actually rectangles including many squares. See here geogebra.org/m/zccvjdj8 my calculations (done afterwards since I managed to create the model using simply visual cues) for the proportions and angles required for the 5 first faces at the center that can then be duplicated and moved to create the others.

*\*Requiered camera pitch angle is asin(tan(18°)) ≈ 18.961° for this dimetric view instead of [≈ 35.264° for standard isometric view](//w.wiki/9vtL)*.

name: Orion nuclear propulsion spacecraft
description:
Project Orion was a study conducted in the 1950s and 1960s by the United States Air Force, DARPA, and NASA into the viability of a nuclear pulse spaceship that would be directly propelled by a series of atomic explosions behind the craft.Early versions of the vehicle were proposed to take off from the ground; later versions were presented for use only in space. The design effort took place at General Atomics in San Diego, and supporters included Wernher von Braun, who issued a white paper advocating the idea. Non-nuclear tests were conducted with models, but the project was eventually abandoned for several reasons, including the 1963 Partial Test Ban Treaty, which banned nuclear explosions in space, and concerns over nuclear fallout. Note: This model is made with imagination base on the "real concept".

Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Project_Orion_(nuclear_propulsion)

name: Excavations at Tell Abu Al Gudour, Beheira
description:
# Tell Abu Gudour Archaeological Site - Ptolemaic Bath Complex

### 🏛️ About the Model
Tell Abu Gudour is a registered archaeological site in Beheira, Egypt, featuring architectural layers spanning from the Ptolemaic to the Byzantine eras. This model documents a newly uncovered Ptolemaic public bath complex and related structural units in the northeastern sector of the tell.

---

### ⚙️ Technical Details & Photogrammetry
* **Method:** Aerial & Ground 3D Photogrammetry
* **Site Dimensions:** 61 × 84 meters
* **Dataset:** 5,960 high-resolution photographs
* **Software:** Agisoft Metashape Professional (v2.2.1)

---

### 🙌 Field Team & Credits
Special thanks to the amazing field team:
* Ahmed Abdelhady Ebrahim.
* Essam Hassan Ali.
* Mahmod Morsy.
* Heba Saad Soliman.
* Mahdy Mohamed Saleh.
* Mohamed.

---

### 📊 Credits & Affiliation
* **3D Recording & Photogrammetry by:** Waleed Nosir.
* **Affiliation:** Archaeology Inspector, Egyptian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities .

name: Daga del siglo XX
description:
Daga de hierro con empuñadura de madera, conservada casi en su totalidad y con evidentes signos de corrosión en la hoja como consecuencia del paso del tiempo.

La pieza presenta una hoja recta de doble filo y una pequeña guarda metálica. La empuñadura, realizada en madera torneada, conserva un interesante detalle constructivo: el remate del pomo fue elaborado reutilizando una moneda de una peseta, lo que indica que, al menos en su configuración actual, no puede ser anterior al siglo XX.

La reutilización de objetos cotidianos en la fabricación o reparación de herramientas y armas fue una práctica relativamente frecuente, convirtiendo esta daga en un ejemplo de cómo materiales de distinta procedencia podían integrarse en un mismo objeto para prolongar su vida útil.

description: Purussaurus was a gigantic caiman that lived in South America during the Miocene, around 8–5 million years ago. It reached lengths of up to 12 meters (39 ft) and weighed over 8 tons, making it one of the largest crocodilians ever. Its skull was about 1.4 meters long, with bone-crushing jaws and a bite force estimated at 69,000 Newtons—far stronger than any living crocodile. Purussaurus lived in vast wetland systems like the Pebas, where it preyed on fish, turtles, mammals, and even other reptiles. As an apex predator, it shaped its ecosystem, but it vanished as climate and habitats changed, reducing food sources. Closely related to modern caimans, Purussaurus shows how powerful and diverse crocodilians once were.

name: Eiffel Tower Phone
description:
The Eiffel Tower Phone is a piece with a history behind it. I’ve always had a soft spot for vintage objects, so I decided to recreate this one. Of course, this is a replica - there are very few references of the original phone left, and as every artist knows, good references are everything.
The original model dates back to 1892. From what I could gather, it didn’t even have the kind of dialing system we’re used to today.
But honestly, let’s skip the theory - this project was all about the joy of creating something rich in detail and character, with lots of intricate elements to explore and bring to life.

name: Urbieta kalea 46, Donostia
description:
El portal de Urbieta Kalea 46 se localiza en el corazón del Ensanche de San Sebastián (Barrio Centro), una de las principales zonas urbanas de la ciudad. La arquitectura de esta área es característica del desarrollo burgués de finales del siglo XIX y principios del XX.

El edificio al que pertenece este portal se inscribe en el estilo señorial propio del Ensanche. Las fachadas de Urbieta Kalea suelen ser uniformes, de altura media-alta, con elementos distintivos como miradores acristalados (típicos de Donostia) y balcones de hierro forjado.

El portal en sí mismo, como acceso a una finca residencial de alto valor en una zona céntrica, es generalmente sobrio pero elegante. Es común que su diseño interior utilice materiales nobles como piedra o mármol en el revestimiento. En resumen, este portal representa la arquitectura clásica, residencial y elegante del centro de Donostia-San Sebastián.

name: Kate Kelly
description: The 126 ft two-masted schooner Kate Kelly was built in 1867 in Tonawanda, NY. In its twenty-eight-year career it was wrecked and repaired multiple times -- much more than most ships probably due to poor captaining. With repair bills mounting the owners were unable to pay the bills and it was sold at auction in 1877. As the ship aged and became leakier it was unable to carry cargoes of grain or iron products and was mostly confined to hauling lumber products. In 1895 it was hauling a load of hemlock railroad ties from Alpena to Chicago when it capsized and sank in a bad storm off Wind Point Light near Racine. Today it is a popular Wisconsin dive site.  The model was created from 1,945 30-megapixel images shot by Andrew Goodman with support from Kendra Kennedy on a joint Wisconsin Historic Society and GLSPS 3DShipwrecks project.

name: ルーブル彫刻美術館 — 時を刻む彫像の回廊
description:
三重県津市にある ルーブル彫刻美術館 は、
フランス・ルーブル美術館の正式許諾を受け、
歴史的な名作彫刻のレプリカを公開する国内でも貴重な施設です。

展示室には、ルネサンス以降の西洋彫刻を代表する像が並び、
室内照明の柔らかな陰影の中で、作品の輪郭や表情が静かに浮かび上がります。
鑑賞者が歩みを進めるごとに、光の向きと距離が変化し、
彫像たちはまるで異なる表情を見せてくれます。

今回の記録は、館内の雰囲気をそのまま残すため、
360°写真による時点保存（アーカイブ） を目的として撮影したものです。
光の反射、床の模様、素材の質感、そして作品同士の空間的バランスを
できるだけ忠実に再現しています。

文化施設の環境そのものを 360° で残すことは、
後世にとって「当時の鑑賞体験」を共有するための貴重な資料となります。
このモデルが、美術館の魅力や文化的価値を知るきっかけになれば幸いです。

name: Mitsubishi A6M Zero
description: The Mitsubishi A6M "Zero" is a long-range carrier-based fighter aircraft formerly manufactured by Mitsubishi Aircraft Company, a part of Mitsubishi Heavy Industries. It was operated by the Imperial Japanese Navy (IJN) from 1940 to 1945. The A6M was designated as the Mitsubishi Navy Type 0 carrier fighter[1] (零式艦上戦闘機, rei-shiki-kanjō-sentōki), or the Mitsubishi A6M Rei-sen. The A6M was usually referred to by its pilots as the Reisen (零戦, zero fighter), "0" being the last digit of the imperial year 2600 (1940) when it entered service with the Imperial Navy. The official Allied reporting name was "Zeke", although the name "Zero" was used colloquially as well.

name: 1994 Kineto RM-X (Fictional JDM Sports Car)
description:
Original design inspired by the Honda NSX and the Mazda RX7 FD3S, with styling influences from a number of additional cars including the Mitsubishi FTO, Nissan 300ZX, C5 Corvette & the Jaguar XJR-15

Created for use in a racing game that's currently in development using Godot - videos of the project can be found on [YouTube](https://youtu.be/_f7zamvXqCo)

A low-poly, PS1-style version of this car is available to download for free [here](https://skfb.ly/oSusV)

--
Envisioned as a mid-engined, rear-wheel-drive performance car powered by a twin-turbocharged 3-rotor making 240 horsepower, the RM-X was built to go toe-to-toe with the prestigious European exotics of the time.

In the United States it was sold under Kineto's luxury branch "Intresta" (the *Intresta RM-X*), as Americans had come to associate Kineto with affordable economy cars.  In all other markets, though, it was sold as the "Kineto RM-X".

name: Wheelbarrow / Pushcart
description:
This 3D model is a personal project depicting a low poly wheelbarrow and shovel, optimized for gaming environments. Key features include:

Low Poly Optimization: Each element has been meticulously modeled to maintain a low polygon count, ensuring optimal performance in gaming scenarios.

Normal Map Baking Process: The normal map baking technique has been applied to transfer details from a high-poly object to the low-poly geometry, enhancing visual representation without increasing polygonal overhead.

Trim Sheet for UV Optimization: The trim sheet methodology, incorporating UV overlays, has been employed to reduce the number of UV islands, resulting in a final texture with higher resolution.

Specific details include 674 triangles for the shovel and 5,394 triangles for the wheelbarrow.
I hope you enjoy it. Please share your thoughts on the asset.

This is an older model that was created for 2D artistic reference use only, with facets that may be exaggerated, outdated, or incomplete. It is not meant to be taken as an accurate palentological render. Please reference this to your heart’s desire with this in mind, and, optionally, send me your finished creations!

name: Svaranc Сваранц Սուրբ Հազարափրկիչ եկեղեցի
description:
Сваранц — это высокогорное село в Сюникской области Армении, расположенное у северного подножия горы Арамазд.  Село расположено в верховьях реки Татев на высоте около 1750 метров над уровнем моря.  В селе находится церковь Азарапркич (S. Azaraprkich), построенная в 1705 году. Близ села расположено Сваранцское железорудное месторождение — самое крупное в Армении. Церковь Азарапркич также известна как церковь Всеспасителя или Сурб Аменапркич. Справа от входа сохранилась надпись из шести строк, датированная 1705 годом, в которой упоминается имя мастера-строителя — Геворг. 
Սվարանց գյուղը գտնվում է Սյունիքի մարզում՝ Տաթևի վանքից հարավ-արևմուտք, Արամազդ լեռան հյուսիսային փեշերին: Սուրբ Հազարափրկիչ եկեղեցի, գյուղի կենտրոնում գտնվող այս տաճարը Սյունիքի ուշ միջնադարյան ճարտարապետության արժեքավոր նմուշ է: Մուտքի աջ կողմում պահպանվել է 1705 թվականի վեցտողանոց արձանագրություն, որտեղ նշված է շինարար վարպետի անունը՝ Գևորգ:  2008-2009 թթ. եկեղեցին հիմնովին վերականգնվել է բարերար Վրեժ Գալստյանի միջոցներով:

name: Patrick Seymour (1779/5) Headstone
description: One of 162 headstones in Castletownarra graveyard (TN019-002002-), County Tipperary, recorded in 1982 by the Ormond Historical Society. 19th-century slate headstone marking the grave of Patrick Seymour (born c. 1779 or 1775) who died on the 3rd of May in 1826 aged 47 or 41 years old. The memorial was erected by his son Patrick Seymour. Above the inscription there is an I H S Christogram with lozenge-filled Latin-Cross rising from the top of the H, flanked on either side by the Hand-of-God, with trumpeting angel on top of the cross. Either side of the cross there is an encircled six-pointed star/rosette/hexafoil/daisy-wheel and a soul effigy. An encircled crowing-rooster to the left of the cross as you look at the memorial and Noah’s Dove to the right standing on top of an olive tree. The inscription is framed by a decorative border filled with a V-shaped pattern. Probably the work of the stonecutter T. Gunning.

name: Stylized Wooden Robot - Triverse AI 3D Character
description:
A stylized wooden robot character with a handcrafted, toy-like feel. I was going for a mix of mechanical structure and organic wood texture—something that feels both solid and a bit nostalgic.

Focused on keeping the forms readable and balanced, especially around the joints and torso, while adding subtle surface detail to give it more personality. The slightly worn wood texture helps sell the idea of an old but reliable companion.

This piece started as an AI-generated base using [Triverse AI](http://triverse.ai), mainly to explore shape and proportions quickly, and then I refined it a bit afterward. It’s been a pretty interesting workflow for blocking out ideas fast and iterating on character concepts.

Curious to hear what you think or how you'd use something like this in a game or scene 👀:)

This ceramic vase comes from the archaeological investigations carried out in 1905 by Paolo Emilio Stasi in the Zinzulusa Cave, in Puglia.

It was donated to Arturo Issel and became part of the former collections of the Geological Museum, nowadays included in the DISTAV collections at the University of Genoa.

The shape of the vase and its decoration allow to date it to 6,500 years ago. This model has been recently restored.

This 3D model was realized by Clarissa Bignoli and Erika Del Bene during the Universal Civil Service (SCU) at UniGe.

name: Low Poly Spinosaurus
description: Spinosaurus (/ˌspaɪnəˈsɔːrəs/; lit. 'spine lizard') is a genus of spinosaurid dinosaur that lived in what now is North Africa during the Cenomanian to upper Turonian stages of the Late Cretaceous period, about 99 to 93.5 million years ago.[2][3] The genus was known first from Egyptian remains discovered in 1912 and described by German palaeontologist Ernst Stromer in 1915. The original remains were destroyed in World War II, but additional material came to light in the early 21st century. It is unclear whether one or two species are represented in the fossils reported in the scientific literature. The best known species is S. aegyptiacus from Egypt, although a potential second species, S. maroccanus, has been recovered from Morocco. The contemporary spinosaurid genus Sigilmassasaurus has also been synonymized by some authors with S. aegyptiacus, though other researchers propose it to be a distinct taxon. Another possible junior synonym is Oxalaia from the Alcântara Formation in Brazil.

name: Casa M|K - Condomínio Aquaville 2.0
description:
O projeto hidrossanitário contempla o dimensionamento e detalhamento dos sistemas de abastecimento de água fria e quente, com pressurização, além dos sistemas de drenagem pluvial e esgotamento sanitário da edificação.

O sistema de água foi projetado para garantir vazão e pressão adequadas aos pontos de consumo, com distribuição por gravidade e/ou pressurização. A rede de água quente considera a demanda de uso e isolamento térmico das tubulações.

A condução pluvial prevê a captação e condução das águas de chuva por meio de calhas e condutores, evitando acúmulos e infiltrações.

O sistema de esgoto contempla a coleta e condução dos efluentes, com dimensionamento, ventilação e declividade adequados, garantindo o correto funcionamento.

Os sistemas atendem às normas técnicas vigentes, garantindo a eficiência e a segurança das instalações.

The loggerhead sea turtle (*Caretta caretta*) is a species of oceanic turtle belonging to the family Cheloniidae distributed throughout the world. It is found in the Atlantic, Pacific, and Indian Oceans, as well as the Mediterranean Sea. The average loggerhead measures around 90 cm in carapace length when fully grown and the adult weighs approximately 135 kg, with the largest specimens weighing in at more than 450 kg.
The loggerhead sea turtle is omnivorous, feeding mainly on bottom-dwelling invertebrates. Its large and powerful jaws serve as an effective tool for dismantling its prey.



Specimen: Loggerhead sea turtle, *Caretta caretta* (Linnaeus, 1758)

name: Woman Seated on a Bench (c.400-201 BCE)
description:
At first glance, this is a small and quiet object: a woman seated on a bench, wrapped in a simple chiton. Yet figures like this open onto one of the most revealing traditions in ancient Greek art. Tanagra figurines brought ordinary human presence into terracotta with unusual grace, and they were not made to be merely looked at. They moved between the home, the sanctuary, and the grave, carrying meanings that were domestic, religious, and funerary at once. Just as striking is the fact that this figure was once brightly painted. What now appears muted and fragmentary would originally have been a lively, colorful image, much closer to the world of the living than many modern viewers expect from ancient sculpture.

View artifact: https://thevimu.com/woman-seated-on-a-bench-c-400-201-bce/

Credit: "Woman Seated on a Bench | NCMA Explore" (https://skfb.ly/oKwUp) by NCMA Explore | North Carolina Museum of Art is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

They were designed by the Soviet Union in the 1960s and 1970s to give mechanized infantry better mobility, firepower, and protection on the battlefield. The BMP-1 was widely exported and participated in various conflicts around the world, such as the Arab-Israeli wars, the Iran-Iraq war, the Afghan war, and the Chechen wars. The BMP-1P was introduced in the late 1970s and featured enhanced anti-tank capabilities, smoke grenade launchers and additional armour. The BMP-1P was also extensively used by Soviet and Warsaw Pact forces, as well as by some of their allies and adversaries.

name: Ammonite - Hildoceras sp.
description:
**Nom** : *Hildoceras sp.*

**Descrition** : Les ammonites pyriteuses sont le résultat d’un processus de fossilisation inhabituel : la pyritisation. Ce phénomène se produit lorsque les sédiments environnants sont pauvres en oxygène, créant un environnement anoxique favorable à la formation de pyrite (FeS₂) autour et dans les coquilles fossiles. Dans ce milieu, la matière organique se décompose lentement, permettant aux minéraux ferreux présents dans les eaux de sédimentation de remplacer la coquille d’origine, formant ainsi un moulage en pyrite.

**Dimensions** : 4,1 cm x 3,5 cm x 1,4 cm.

**Âge** : Toarcien, Jurassique inférieur.

**Localité** : inconnue.

**Méthode** : Acquisition de 509 photos avec Appareil Reflexe APS-C dans Studio Photos. Balance des blancs et colorimétrie par CaptureOne et Colorchecker. Modèle reconstruit par photogrammétrie.

**Réalisation** : Yann Ternois - SIGéo - CEREGE - OSU PYTHEAS - Aix-Marseille Université - Juillet 2026.

The most remarkable thing about the Zenvo TSR-S isn't its four-figure power output, its seven-figure price tag, nor the fact that its V-8 engine is force fed by two superchargers. Neither is it its claimed 6.8-second zero-to-124-mph time, which matches McLaren's claim of the Senna and is sufficient to make it one of the quickest street-legal cars on the planet. It's not even that Zenvo remains Denmark's only native automaker, despite having built only 15 cars since its foundation in 2009. While all of these points are certainly interesting, none gets close to the crowd-drawing effect of the TSR-S's unique aerodynamics.

**Wind and Fire**

Like most hypercars, the Zenvo has a sizable rear wing, but in addition to being adjustable in the normal fore-aft plane it uses two hydraulic actuators that can pivot it by up to 20 degrees on the car's longitudinal axis. name: La Iglesia de Santianes por etapas constructivas
description:
La iglesia de San Juan Apóstol y Evangelista, en Santianes de Pravia, es la más antigua que se conserva en la arquitectura prerrománica asturiana. Fue erigida por iniciativa del Rey Silo (774-783), después del traslado de la corte de Cangas de Onís a Pravia, y concebida como iglesia palatina con funciones de panteón real. La iglesia permaneció intacta hasta el siglo XVI, pero sufrió profundas transformaciones en los siglos XVII y XIX. En 1894, se descubrieron importantes restos arquitectónicos de la iglesia primitiva: una pilastra que servía de apoyo a las mesas del altar y dos canceles. Estas piezas fueron adquiridas por el historiador Fortunato de Selgas (1839-1921), en 1905.

name: Animated Skull Crawler
description:
A highly detailed ultra-realistic 3D creature asset of the Skull Crawler / Skull Devil, inspired by cinematic kaiju and dark fantasy monster design. The model features dense high-poly sculpting with layered skin folds, wrinkles, micro surface breakup, and organic damage details to enhance realism and cinematic presence. It is supported by clean and optimized topology suitable for animation, rigging, and production workflows, with proper edge flow for deformation and further detailing. The asset is structured for PBR-based rendering, delivering realistic material response in both Cycles and Eevee, making it ideal for close-up shots and cinematic lighting. Perfect for VFX sequences, game development, horror and fantasy environments, creature concept art, and animation projects where a high-end, terrifying creature design is required.

Want to buy this 3D model? Click the link below to get yours! 👇🏼

name: coral (parasmilia centralis)
description:
Parasmilia centralis was a species of coral that lived in shallow tropical seas during the Early Cretaceous period. It had a massive calcium carbonate skeleton, similar to that of modern reef-building corals. It likely lived in symbiosis with zooxanthellae, which made it sensitive to changes in light and temperature.
Fossils of this species have been found across Europe, including in France and the Czech Republic. After the asteroid impact at the end of the Cretaceous, a mass extinction event wiped out many marine species—including this coral.
Although we can no longer see this coral in today’s oceans, we can still admire its structure through detailed 3D models.
